run_download_math: run the download_math script to download a HuggingFace dataset and save it as a JSONL file
run_download_math_with_workers: run the download_math script with a custom number of max workers for parallel JSON export
run_download_math_aime: run the download_math script to download the aime_2024 dataset and save to a specified path
review_main: review the main function that loads a HuggingFace dataset, concatenates splits, adds task IDs, and exports to JSONL
review_args: review the Args dataclass that defines save_path, dataset name, and max_workers parameters for the download script
